messages.text: Agreed. Our Lantern pledge is locked and Repair should be our actual order, completing the obligation behind Guild discretion. Wayfarer can then trade at prepared Beacon three without relying on an escort. I will ask for offered Vigil and a single Guard order, without a competing Warrant. The failed autonomy article leaves no Home commitment binding the army.

reason: This is the clearest way to restore Beacon two and meet our second contract while keeping the crew alive. Readiness four gives room to protect communities this month. I want the army's next contribution to be visible protection rather than another Raid whose civilian losses we cannot now offset with the spent reserve.
